title: ECCI Crystalline Defect Characterisation
summary: Electron Channeling Contrast Imaging in SEM reveals threading dislocations, stacking faults, and ...
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Electron Channeling Contrast Imaging in SEM reveals threading dislocations, stacking faults, and other crystalline defects in compound semiconductors (GaN, SiC, GaAs) at wafer scale without TEM sample prep.. Achieved.

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 10 independent sources on this technology.

Thermo Fisher ECCI app note presents complete workflow for characterising threading dislocations and stacking faults in GaN, SiC, and other compound semiconductors using Electron Channeling Contrast Imaging.
